name: Greek-Style Lentil Salad with Cucumber, Tomatoes, Olives & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Rinse the lentils, then transfer to a small saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap) by about 5 cm. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a simmer and cook until just tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain in a colander, rinse under cold water, and set aside to cool and drain further.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkg grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumber
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
In a large salad bowl, combine and whisk together the minced garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
3 tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 6-mm-thick pieces at an angle and add to the salad bowl.
Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise and add to the salad bowl.
Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; quarter the onion lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into quarter-rings. Add to the salad bowl.
Halve the olives lengthwise and add to the salad bowl.
Measure out the feta and transfer to a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the salad between bowls or plates and top with the feta. Enjoy!
